victim.name: Arthur Pembroke
victim.role: Owner of Ashford Private Railway Station

suspects.name: Helen Ward
suspects.motive: Arthur had discovered irregularities in the station accounts.

suspects.name: Victor Hale
suspects.motive: Arthur planned to remove Victor from his position after a serious dispute.

suspects.name: Nora Ellis
suspects.motive: Arthur had threatened to terminate Nora's employment.

suspects.name: Thomas Reed
suspects.motive: Arthur blamed Thomas for a costly signalling failure.

clues.name: The Disciplinary Notice
clues.description: A signed notice indicates that Arthur intended to dismiss the station manager.

clues.name: The Platform Camera
clues.description: A recording appears to show Victor near the Station Master's Office at 22:14, despite his claim that he remained on Platform Two.

clues.name: The Accountant's Receipt
clues.description: A receipt places Helen at the Ticket Office shortly after 22:10, consistent with part of her alibi.

clues.name: The Cleaning Record
clues.description: A signed cleaning log supports Nora's presence in the Waiting Room at 22:16.

clues.name: The Signal Interruption
clues.description: A maintenance log records a brief signalling interruption near the time of the incident, but does not identify who caused it.

clues.name: The Torn Schedule
clues.description: A torn railway schedule contains a handwritten note about a private meeting with Arthur. The author is unknown.

clues.name: The Office Key
clues.description: The spare key to the Station Master's Office is missing. Several employees had legitimate access to it.

clues.name: The Passenger's Account
clues.description: A passenger recalls seeing someone in a dark uniform near the office around 22:20 but cannot identify the person reliably.
